name: Hallowed Memorandum

angles.text: As a gnome, you bring curiosity and sharp intellect to the study of the Light, pondering its holy mysteries alongside your faith.
As a priest, you begin formal instruction in Coldridge Valley and learn the philosophy of the Holy Light as a healer.

faq.answer: A local ally passes the Hallowed Memorandum to you while you help in Coldridge Valley. Branstock Khalder, the priest trainer inside Anvilmar, sent it.
Branstock Khalder is a dwarven priest trainer inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley. He teaches young priests to understand the Light and use holy power to heal wounds or smite evil.

aliases: how do gnomes view the light
faq.answer: Branstock says gnomes can draw on curiosity and intellect to understand the Light. He urges them to ponder it as a philosophical riddle that brings thought and feeling together.
faq.q: How do gnomes approach the Holy Light?

aliases: what is the light according to branstock
faq.answer: Branstock teaches that the Light is a riddle, not a rigid technical discipline. Its blessings and lessons come through joining thought with inner feeling.
faq.q: What does Branstock teach about the Light?

faq.answer: As a priest begins to understand the Light, Branstock teaches how to channel it into healing prayers and holy blows against the wicked, in exchange for modest donations.
faq.q: What abilities does Branstock offer to teach?

faq.answer: You can find Branstock Khalder inside Anvilmar, the central fortress and welcoming hall in the heart of Coldridge Valley, Dun Morogh. Trainers and refuge for dwarves and visiting gnomes are found there.
faq.q: Where can Branstock Khalder be found?

sections.body: While you aid allies in Coldridge Valley, promising gnome novices receive the Hallowed Memorandum. It directs them to Branstock Khalder inside Anvilmar, where their formal spiritual study begins in Dun Morogh.
sections.title: A Summons to Anvilmar

sections.body: Branstock Khalder welcomes each novice who brings the memorandum. He teaches that the Holy Light is a deep riddle, not a rigid craft. It calls for curiosity, keen thought, and harmony between intellect and feeling. Through contemplation and practice, students learn to channel its mysteries into healing and holy retribution.
sections.title: Puzzles of the Faith

summary: At Anvilmar, young gnome priests are summoned to study the Holy Light through the Hallowed Memorandum. It sends them to Branstock Khalder in Coldridge Valley, where curiosity and intellect meet a faith to ponder.
